0022600210.text: The Golden State Warriors, 7-3 and riding a seven-game winning streak, host the New Orleans Pelicans in the Warriors' 11th game of the 2026-27 season, sitting 2nd in the Pacific, 1.5 games back, and 5th in the West. The Pelicans, 4-6 and on a two-game losing streak, are 5th in the Southwest, 4 games back, and 11th in the West, and Golden State is without Jimmy Butler III and Moses Moody (both knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), and Will Richard (thumb), while Gary Payton II and Gui Santos are day-to-day with knee issues and are game-time decisions; New Orleans is missing Trendon Watford (ankle), Trey Murphy III (knee tendinitis), and Yves Missi (knee bruise). The teams have not played each other yet this season, the Warriors won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, and the most recent meeting was a 113-109 Pelicans win in New Orleans on February 24, 2026, a regular-season game.
